T: How far she'll go for a good feed.
D: A chief's daughter sails across the ocean to find a demigod and restore the heart of an island.
P: Serve the snacks when the coconut pirates attack the boat.
S: Coconut prawns: prawns dipped in flour, egg and a mix of panko and shredded coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, with a sweet chilli and lime dip.
Raw tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli, spooned onto rice in little cups with cucumber and seaweed.
the gardens and groves on Motunui
Taro peeled with gloves, sliced paper thin, rinsed and dried, fried at 170C until crisp, salted, with a dip of coconut cream whisked with lime juice, zest and a pinch of chilli.
M: the island coming back to life
Snapper fillets cooked gently in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chilli, finished with lime and coriander, served with rice.
a feast fit for a demigod
Chicken thighs marinated overnight in soy, pineapple juice, ginger and garlic, grilled until charred, with thick rings of grilled pineapple and rice cooked in coconut milk.
W: a Pacific coconut pudding for the voyage
Coconut milk, sugar and cornflour whisked together and cooked over medium heat until very thick, poured into a tray, chilled 3 hours, cut into squares, topped with toasted coconut and fresh mango.
K: the song about everything a coconut is good for
Chilled coconut water poured over ice with a squeeze of lime and a few torn mint leaves, served in a halved coconut if you can crack one.

s.how: Dip 500g peeled green prawns in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then a mix of 60g panko and 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.
Cook 200g sushi rice and cool. Dice 300g sashimi tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, spring onion and a little chilli. Spoon rice into small cups, top with tuna and cucumber.

m.note: the island coming back to life
m.how: Simmer 400ml coconut milk with 3 lime leaves, a sliced knob of ginger and a sliced chilli for 5 minutes. Add 600g snapper fillets and poach gently for 8 minutes. Finish with lime juice and coriander. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: a Pacific coconut pudding for the voyage
w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 60g cornflour together in a pot. Stir over medium heat until very thick, pour into a tray and chill 3 hours. Cut into squares and top with toasted shredded coconut and diced mango.

d.note: the song about everything a coconut is good for
d.how: Pour 1L chilled coconut water over ice in four glasses. Add a squeeze of lime and a few torn mint leaves to each. Serve in a halved coconut if you can crack one open.
